blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This paper presents the Digital Typhoon Dataset V3, a new version of the longest typhoon satellite image dataset spanning nearly 50 years, designed to benchmark machine learning models on long-term spatio-temporal data. The latest addition to Dataset V3 is multispectral satellite data, enabling multi-channel models. We investigate data-splitting strategies and present benchmarking results for the Northern and Southern Hemispheres. Experimental results show that, under the current dataset construction and experimental setting, multi-channel inputs do not clearly outperform single-channel inputs for pressure regression. Among the evaluated model architectures, image types, and spectral channels, ResNet-18, full-resolution images, and Channel 1 generally provide the best single-channel performance for pressure regression. Performance also differs between the WP and AU datasets by regression target, with lower RMSE on WP for pressure regression and on AU for wind regression. These results highlight the importance of considering dataset-specific and task-specific characteristics when interpreting benchmark performance. Additionally, we analyzed systematic bias in intensity regression, which leads to underestimation of intensity for strong typhoons. We tested imbalance-aware weighting strategies, including inverse-density weighting inspired by BalancedMSE, and showed that these approaches are not sufficient to remove the bias. The dataset is publicly available at http://agora.ex.nii.ac.jp/digital-typhoon/dataset/ and https://github.com/kitamoto-lab/digital-typhoon/.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍数字台风数据集V3,这是新版最长的台风卫星影像数据集,持续了近50年,旨在将机器学习模型作为长期时空数据的基准. 对Dataset V3的最新添加是多光谱卫星数据,使多通道模型成为可能. 我们调查分享数据的战略,并提出南北半球的基准结果。 实验结果表明,在目前的数据集构建和实验设置下,多渠道输入不能明显地超过单渠道输入来进行压力回流. 在被评价的模型架构中,图像类型和光谱通道,ResNet-18,全分辨率图像,以及1频道一般为压力回流提供最好的单通道性能. WP和非盟数据集的性能也因回归目标而异,WP上压回归的RMSE更低,而非盟上压回归的RMSE更低. 这些结果突出表明,在解释基准业绩时必须考虑到数据集的具体特点和任务的具体特点。 此外,我们分析了强度回归的系统性偏差,这导致低估了强烈台风的强度。 我们测试了认识到不平衡的权重战略,包括受到平衡型MSE启发的反密度权重,并表明这些方法不足以消除偏见。 该数据集可在以下网站公开查阅:http://agora.ex.nii.ac.jp/digital-typhon/dataset/和https://github.com/kitamoto-lab/digital-typhon.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The Digital Typhoon Dataset was first introduced in November 2023 as a machine learning dataset for tropical cyclones [ 13 ] . It contained typhoon-centered satellite images with best-track data from the Japan Meteorological Agency. It was designed to support a range of machine learning tasks, including intensity forecasting. The dataset is unique in its long temporal coverage, spanning 1978 to 2025 and encompassing nearly 50 years of typhoon observations.
blocks.zh: 数字台风数据集于2023年11月首次被引入为热带气旋的机器学习数据集 [13]. 它载有以台风为中心的卫星图像,并附有日本气象厅的最佳跟踪数据。 它旨在支持一系列机器学习任务,包括强度预测. 该数据集在时间覆盖面很长方面是独一无二的,涵盖范围从1978年到2025年,涵盖近50年的台风观测.

blocks.en: We also extended this dataset to a few additional dimensions. Version 2 of the dataset, released in November 2024, extended it to the Southern Hemisphere, enabling comparisons of machine learning models across both hemispheres to understand regional differences [ 12 ] . The dataset size also increased from 54GB to 77GB by adding data from the latest season and a new hemisphere.
blocks.zh: 我们还将这一数据集扩大到几个额外的维度。 数据集第2版于2024年11月发布,将数据扩展至南半球,可以对两半球的机器学习模型进行比较,以了解区域差异[12]. 数据集的大小也从54GB增加到了77GB,增加了上个赛季和新半球的数据.

blocks.en: This paper introduces Version 3 of the dataset. It extends the dataset in the spectral dimension by adding more satellite channels. Versions 1 and 2 offered only an infrared channel; Version 3 added a second infrared channel, a water vapor channel, and a near-infrared channel to capture different aspects of tropical cyclones. As a result, the dataset size increased to 164.9GB for the WP and 66.4GB for the AU, for a total of 231.3GB.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍数据集第3版. 它通过增加更多的卫星通道来扩展光谱维度中的数据集. 第1和2版只提供红外信道;第3版增加了第二个红外信道、水蒸汽信道和近红外信道来捕捉热带气旋的不同方面。 因此,WP的数据集尺寸增加到164.9GB,非盟的数据集尺寸增加到66.4GB,总计231.3GB.

blocks.en:
These channels raise research questions about whether multi-spectral models outperform single-channel models. To test this hypothesis, we trained basic vision models to evaluate single- and multi-channel model performance on this dataset. Additionally, we explored strategies to analyze systematic bias in intensity regression, which leads to underestimation of intensity for
strong typhoons.
blocks.zh:
这些渠道提出了多光谱模型是否优于单通道模型的研究问题. 为了测试这个假说,我们训练了基本的视觉模型,以在这个数据集上评价单道和多道模型的性能. 此外,我们探讨了分析强度回归中系统性偏差的战略,这导致低估了强度。

blocks.en: 2 Digital Typhoon Dataset V3
blocks.zh: 2 数字台风数据集 V3

blocks.en: 2.1 Temporal Dimension
blocks.zh: 2.1 时间方面

blocks.en: As in the V2 dataset, we provide separate datasets for the two hemispheres: the Northern Hemisphere dataset (WP: Western Pacific) and the Southern Hemisphere dataset (AU: Around Australia). For both hemispheres, we extended the temporal dimension with annual updates. For the Northern Hemisphere, we added data for the 2025 typhoon season (January-December 2025) using best-track data from the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA). For the Southern Hemisphere, we also added data for the 2025 cyclone season (July 2024–June 2025) using best-track data from the Bureau of Meteorology (BoM), Australia.
blocks.zh: 与V2数据集一样,我们为两个半球分别提供数据集:北半球数据集(WP:西太平洋)和南半球数据集(AU:环澳大利亚). 对两个半球来说,我们通过每年更新,扩大了时间范围。 就北半球而言,我们利用日本气象厅(JMA)的最佳跟踪数据,增加了2025年台风季(2025年1-12月)的数据。 对于南半球,我们还利用来自澳大利亚气象局的最佳路径数据,增加了2025年气旋季(2024年7月至2025年6月)的数据。

blocks.en:
A new addition to the dataset is the spectral dimension; namely, multiple channels from the Himawari satellite series.
The first satellite, Himawari-1, has two channels: infrared and visible. In later generations, the number of channels increased by adding more channels with narrower bandwidths. The latest satellites, Himawari 8 and 9, each have 16 channels.
More channels (wavelengths) are driven by observational and research needs to capture different aspects of the Earth system. More channels may enable improved analysis and forecasting of tropical cyclones.
blocks.zh:
数据集新增了光谱维度;即从喜玛瓦里卫星系列的多通道.
第一颗卫星喜玛瓦里一号有两道:红外线和可见道. 在后世,由于增加了更多带宽更窄的频道,频道数量有所增加. 最新的卫星喜玛华里8和9各有16个频道.
更多的信道(波长)由观测驱动,需要研究捕获地球系统的不同方面. 更多的渠道可以改进对热带气旋的分析和预测。

blocks.en:
Sensor characteristics have evolved across satellite generations, so matching channel specifications is not straightforward. For example, in the early days of the Himawari series, there was only one infrared channel, and its wavelength range was later split into two. In this case, we could define channel identities in several ways. Here, we prioritize dataset continuity and assign the same number to channels that overlap in wavelength. Under this policy, we assign the first infrared channel to Channel 1 and the second infrared channel to Channel 2, which appeared after Himawari-5. As a result, we map the channel number to wavelengths available for each satellite as summarized in
Table 3 . As this table shows, the wavelength definitions for each channel differ across satellites, but the wavelength ranges overlap across satellite generations. Using this channel number, the Digital Typhoon Dataset V1 and V2 contained only Channel 1, whereas V3 includes new channels: 2, 3, and 4.
blocks.zh:
传感器特性在卫星代相传而来,因此相匹配的信道规格并不直截了当. 例如,喜马拉雅系列早期只有一个红外通道,其波长范围后来被一分为二. 在这种情况下,我们可以以几种方式定义频道身份. 在这里,我们优先考虑数据集的连续性,并给波长重叠的信道分配相同的数字. 根据这一政策,我们将第一个红外信道分配到1频道,第二个红外信道分配到2频道,该频道是在喜马拉雅5后出现的. 因此,我们将频道号映射到每颗卫星可用的波长,摘要如下:

blocks.en:
Because Channel 1 and Channel 2 are next to each other in the spectrum,
they exhibit very similar spectral characteristics, and the difference between the two channels, rather than their raw values, is used to classify cloud types. In the following benchmarking tasks, we used raw values as input data. An alternative approach is to use the difference between the two channels, but we leave it for future work.
blocks.zh:
因为1频道和2频道在相邻的光谱中,
它们表现出非常相近的光谱特性,两个通道之间的区别,而不是它们的原始值,被用来对云类型进行分类. 在以下基准任务中,我们使用原始值作为输入数据. 另一种办法是利用这两个渠道之间的区别,但我们把它留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: Channel 3, called Water Vapor, was introduced after GOES-9. It captures moisture in the upper troposphere and shows moisture-transport dynamics. It exhibits smoother patterns than other channels because it samples only the upper troposphere, owing to atmospheric transparency.
blocks.zh: 第3频道叫"水蒸发"(Water Vapor),是GOES-9后推出的. 它捕捉上对流层的水分,并显示出水分迁移动态. 它表现出比其他渠道更平滑的模式,因为由于大气透明,它只取样对流层上层.

blocks.en: Channel 4, called Near Infrared, spans the electromagnetic spectrum that overlaps the visible and infrared regions. At night, it is close to infrared, but during the day, it incorporates information from sunlight. This diurnal pattern may confound machine learning models for tasks unrelated to diurnal patterns.
blocks.zh: 第4频道被称作"近红外"(Near Infred),横跨了可视和红外区域相重叠的电磁光谱. 在夜间,它接近红外线,但在白天,它吸收了来自阳光的信息. 这种日出模式可能会为与日出模式无关的任务而混淆机器学习模式.

blocks.en: Users may wonder why we did not include visible channels in the dataset, as they have been observed throughout the Himawari series. We decided not to include visible channels for the following reasons. First, because visible channels measure sunlight reflectance, they are meaningful only during the day. The raw value depends on the solar zenith angle. They peak around noon local time but approach zero at night. These strong diurnal patterns complicate model evaluation because the amount of available data differs between day and night. Second, visible channels have historically been more susceptible to noise; over extended periods, they become significantly contaminated and therefore unusable for quantitative analysis. For these reasons, we exclude visible channels from the Digital Typhoon Dataset V3, but we may add them in a future release.
blocks.zh: 用户可能会想,为什么我们没有在数据集中包括可见的通道,因为在整个喜马拉雅系列中都观察到了这些通道. 出于以下原因,我们决定不列入可见频道。 首先,由于可见道测量出阳光反射,它们只在白天才有意义. 生值取决于太阳正角. 它们在当地时间中午左右达到峰值,但晚上接近零点. 这些强烈的日出模式使模型评价复杂化,因为现有数据的数量在白天和夜晚之间有所不同. 第二,从历史上看,可见的渠道更容易受噪音影响;在很长一段时间内,这些渠道被严重污染,因此无法用于定量分析。 由于这些原因,我们从"数字台风数据集V3"中排除了可见的频道,但我们可以在未来的发布中加入.

blocks.en: 2.3 Updates on Pyphoon
blocks.zh: 2.3 关于Pyphon的最新情况

blocks.en: The Python-based software library Pyphoon was also updated to Pyphoon3 , which includes the following features.
blocks.zh: 基于Python的软件库"Pyphon"也被更新为"Pyphon3",其中包含以下功能.

blocks.en: First, it can handle both multi-channel and single-channel datasets. Compared with single-channel datasets, multi-channel datasets must handle cases in which some channels are missing at the same observation time. We require Pyphoon3 to check whether all channels are available at each observation time; if not, we discard that observation time without filling the gap. This results in smaller training and test sets for a multi-channel dataset than for a single-channel dataset.
blocks.zh: 首先,它可以同时处理多道和单道数据集. 相较于单道数据集,多道数据集必须同时处理一些频道缺失的情况. 我们要求Pyphon3检查每个观察时间是否有所有频道;如果没有,我们放弃那个观察时间而不填补空白. 这导致多渠道数据集的培训和测试集比单渠道数据集的集小.

blocks.en:
Second, we updated the data format. We renamed a variable from ’Temperature’ to ’Data’ because not all channels measure
temperature. For example, Channel 3 represents water vapor observations, and Channel 4 represents near-infrared observations. We also modified the dataset’s directory structure. Previously, we organized the dataset into AU and WP directories, where we stored the images and metadata. However, in dataset V3, we first divided the dataset into channel directories 1 to 4, then into hemisphere directories AU and WP. We chose this organization to support single-channel and multi-channel tasks with the same directory structure, and we adapted Pyphoon3 to accommodate these changes.
blocks.zh:
第二,我们更新了数据格式。 我们把一个变量从 " Temperature " 重新命名为 " Data " , 因为并非所有的频道测量
温度。 例如,第3通道代表水蒸发观测,第4通道代表近红外观测。 我们还修改了数据集的目录结构。 之前,我们把数据集整理成非盟目录和WP目录,并存放了图像和元数据。 然而,在数据集V3中,我们首先将数据集分为频道目录1至4,再分为半球目录AU和WP. 我们选择这个组织是为了支持具有相同目录结构的单道和多道任务,我们改造了Pyphon3来适应这些变化.

From now on, we will use Semantic Versioning as follows. First, the major version will be used for major updates, such as format changes or adding new data types. Second, we will add an annual update suffix to indicate the last season.

As a result, the V3 dataset including the 2025 season is named V3-2025. The next annual update, which will include data for the 2026 season, will be named V3-2026.

blocks.en:
Since the release of the Digital Typhoon Dataset [ 13 ] and its

blocks.en: 4 Benchmarking the Digital Typhoon Dataset V3
blocks.zh: 4 数字台风数据集基准V3

blocks.en: 4.1 Dataset Definitions
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集定义

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Single-Channel Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 单一渠道数据集

blocks.en: A single-channel dataset contains all available observations from one satellite channel for a given hemisphere. For example, the Northern Hemisphere dataset containing Channel 1 observations is denoted WP-1, while WP-2, WP-3, and WP-4 denote the corresponding datasets for Channels 2, 3, and 4. The same naming convention applies to the Southern Hemisphere, resulting in AU-1, AU-2, AU-3, and AU-4. Table 2 reports the number of tropical cyclones and images available for each single-channel dataset.
blocks.zh: 单一信道数据集包含从一个卫星信道对某一特定半球的所有现有观测数据。 例如,北半球包含1号频道观测数据的数据集表示WP-1,而WP-2、WP-3和WP-4则表示2、3和4号频道的相应数据集。 同样的命名公约适用于南半球,结果产生了AU-1,AU-2,AU-3和AU-4. 表2报告了热带气旋的数量和每个单一渠道数据集可用的图像。

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Multi-Channel Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 多频道数据集

blocks.en: We construct a multi-channel dataset from the temporal intersection of the four single-channel datasets. An observation is retained only when Channels 1, 2, 3, and 4 are simultaneously available at the same observation time. Consequently, the multi-channel dataset is smaller than any individual single-channel dataset and has a shorter temporal coverage. The resulting multi-channel dataset contains 502 tropical cyclones and 96,579 observations for WP, and 223 tropical cyclones and 40,236 observations for AU. The intersection is slightly smaller than the Channel 4 dataset because we retain only observations with all four channels available.
blocks.zh: 我们从四个单通道数据集的时间相交处构建出一个多通道数据集. 只有在1,2,3和4频道在同一观测时间同时可供使用时,观测才被保留. 因此,多渠道数据集比任何单个单一渠道数据集都小,时间覆盖范围更短. 由此产生的多道数据集包含502个热带气旋和96,579个WP的观测数据,223个热带气旋和40,236个非盟的观测数据. 相接点略小于4频道数据集,因为我们只保留观测数据,所有四个频道都可以使用.

blocks.en: In the benchmarking experiments, we considered three input configurations: Channel 1 + 2, Channel 1 + 3, and Channel 1 + 2 + 3. These configurations all use the same underlying multi-channel dataset defined by the four-channel intersection; they differ only in the subset of channels provided as input to the model. We always include Channel 1 because it has the longest temporal coverage and is the reference channel in the Digital Typhoon Dataset V3. We selected Channel 2 and Channel 3 to evaluate the contribution of complementary spectral information. We did not use Channel 4 as a model input because of its distinct characteristics discussed in Section 2.2 and because the single-channel model for Channel 4 performs poorly, as we show later.
blocks.zh: 在基准实验中,我们考虑了三个输入配置:1频道+2,1频道+3,和1频道+2+3,这些配置都使用由四道相接器定义的相同的基础多道数据集;它们仅在作为输入模型而提供的信道子集中有所不同. 我们总是包括1频道,因为它的时间覆盖时间最长,是数字台风数据集V3中的参考频道. 我们选择了第二频道和第三频道来评价互补光谱信息的贡献. 我们没有使用第4频道作为模型输入,因为它具有2.2节所讨论的不同特点,而且正如我们后来所显示的那样,第4频道的单频道模型表现不佳。

blocks.en: 4.2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4.2 方法

blocks.en: Benchmarking evaluates model performance across different spectral channels, image types, and model architectures.
blocks.zh: 基准评估不同光谱信道、图像类型和模型结构的模型性能。

blocks.en: We first introduce the terminology used in this paper. First, we compare base model architectures between ResNet-18 and ResNet-50, two widely used baseline vision models [ 6 ] . Although they are not the latest models, we continue using them because these models were used to benchmark datasets V1 and V2. Second, we compare three image types; "Full" denotes the full-resolution image ( 512 × 512 512\times 512 ) provided in the dataset; "Resized" denotes a resized version of the full-resolution image to ( 224 × 224 224\times 224 ); and "Cropped" denotes a cropped version centered on the image to ( 224 × 224 224\times 224 ), preserving the original resolution. This definition matches that in our previous paper [ 13 , 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们首先介绍本文件所用的术语。 首先,我们比较ResNet-18和ResNet-50这两个广泛使用的基线远景模型的基础模型架构[6]. 虽然它们不是最新的模型,但我们继续使用它们,因为这些模型被用于基准数据集V1和V2。 其次,我们比较了三种图像类型;"Full"表示数据集中提供的全分辨率图像(512×512/512\times 512);"调整"表示全分辨率图像的大小版本改为(224×224/224\times 224;"cropped"表示以图像为中心被裁剪的版本改为(224×224\times 224),保留了原始分辨率. 这一定义与我们先前的文件[13、12]中的定义一致。

blocks.en:
We then compare spectral channels to test our hypothesis that multi-channel (multi-spectral) models trained on multi-channel datasets can outperform single-channel models trained on single-channel datasets, because the former can account for cross-channel dependencies during training.
We first assess single-channel models and compare their performance across channels, image types, and model architectures. This lets us identify the best-performing choices across these experimental dimensions. Second, we compare single- and multi-channel models and evaluate whether incorporating additional spectral information provides a performance advantage under the current dataset construction. We evaluate performance separately for the WP and AU datasets and for pressure and wind regression, as these represent dataset- and task-specific conditions rather than experimental choices.
blocks.zh:
然后,我们比较光谱通道来测试我们的假设,即在多通道数据集上被训练的多通道(多光谱)模型可以超越在单通道数据集上被训练的单通道模型,因为前者可以在训练中说明跨通道的依赖性.
我们首先评估单频道模型,并比较其跨频道,图像类型,模型架构的性能. 这使得我们可以确定这些实验方面的最佳选择。 第二,我们比较单通道和多通道模型,并评价纳入额外光谱信息是否在当前数据集构建下提供了性能优势. 我们分别评估工作方案和非盟数据集以及压力和风向回归的绩效,因为这些是数据集和任务的具体条件,而不是试验选择。

blocks.en: Based on these settings, we evaluated the regression task primarily on pressure, with wind included for single-channel comparison. We assessed performance separately for WP and AU. We repeated each experiment five times using the same training and evaluation partitions and report the mean RMSE and standard deviation across the five runs.
blocks.zh: 根据这些设置,我们评价了回归任务,主要是在压力下,包括风能单通道比较。 我们分别评估了工作方案和非盟的执行情况。 我们利用同样的训练和评价分区重复了五次试验,并报告了平均RMSE和跨越五跑的标准偏差。

blocks.en: 4.3 Data Splitting
blocks.zh: 4.3 数据分割

blocks.en: For training and evaluation, we consider two approaches: season-level splitting (SS) and sequence-level splitting (SQ). We also introduce notation to specify the splitting parameters. The first is random selection, which assigns a percentage of the dataset to the evaluation set. For example, retaining 20 % 20\% of the dataset for evaluation is denoted R20. The second is the last selection, which specifies the number of units in the evaluation set. For example, retaining the last two seasons for evaluation is denoted L2.
blocks.zh: 关于培训和评价,我们考虑两种办法:季节分级(SS)和顺序分级(SQ)。 我们还采用标记来指定分割参数。 第一个是随机选择,将数据集的一定百分比分配给评价组. 例如,保留20%的20-%用于评价的数据集表示为R20。 第二种是最后的选择,它规定了评价集中的单位数量. 例如,保留最后两个评价季节表示L2.

blocks.en:
Throughout the paper, we primarily use the SS-L2 split for the Digital Typhoon Dataset V3. This means we reserve the last two seasons, 2024 and 2025, as the held-out evaluation set, and use all earlier seasons for training.
In our experimental protocol, evaluation set , validation set , and test set refer to the same held-out subset of the data.
We use the held-out evaluation set to monitor model performance during training and report final benchmark results, but we do not use it to fit any model parameters or weighting scheme; we compute these on the training set alone. We therefore use the term evaluation set throughout the paper to avoid implying a separate validation set.
We made this choice to ensure consistency across experiments and to simulate operational scenarios where historical data is used to analyze and forecast recent or real-time data.
blocks.zh:
在整个论文中,我们主要使用SS-L2分数来进行数字台风数据集V3. 这意味着我们保留最后两个赛季,即2024和2025,作为被搁置评价的设定,并利用所有更早的赛季进行培训.
在我们的实验协议中,评价集,验证集,和测试集是指数据中相同的被搁置子集.
我们利用被搁置的一套评价来监测培训期间的示范业绩并报告最终基准结果,但我们并不使用这套评价来适应任何示范参数或加权办法;我们仅根据培训组合计算这些参数或加权办法。 因此,我们使用整份文件中设定的评价一词,以避免暗示有一套单独的验证。
我们作出这一选择是为了确保各种试验的一致性,并模拟使用历史数据分析和预测近期或实时数据的业务情景。

However, because each channel has different temporal coverage (see Table 3 ), the percentages of the evaluation set vary across channels, which should be considered when interpreting inter-channel performance comparisons. The SQ-R split reduces the effect of different percentages but is still significantly affected by different dataset sizes across channels.

blocks.en: We plan to maintain the same data-splitting scheme for future dataset updates. For example, when we add the 2026 season, the evaluation set will shift to 2025 and 2026, with the 2025 season overlapping with the previous evaluation period. In the future, we could also consider an SQ-L1 split in which machine learning models are trained on all historical data while excluding observations from currently active tropical cyclones. However, we could also separate validation and test sets to make better design choices, such as selecting hyperparameters and training duration. Future work includes exploring other data splitting methods for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们计划在今后更新数据集时维持同样的数据分享计划。 例如,当增加2026个赛季后,评价集将转向2025和2026年,2025年赛季与上一个评价期重叠. 在未来,我们还可以考虑SQ-L1分出,其中机器学习模型对所有历史数据进行培训,同时排除目前活跃的热带气旋的观测. 然而,我们也可以将验证和测试装置分开,以便作出更好的设计选择,例如选择超参数表和培训期限。 今后的工作包括探索其他数据分割评估方法。

blocks.en: 4.4 Optimizer selection
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 优化选择

blocks.en: The choice of optimization algorithm significantly affects training dynamics and, consequently, model performance. In our previous benchmarking on the V1 and V2 datasets, we ran all experiments with the Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) optimizer. Although SGD is widely adopted, we observed slower convergence and greater sensitivity to the learning rate, which affected training stability and reproducibility across experimental settings.
blocks.zh: 优化算法的选择严重影响了培训动态,从而也影响了模型性能. 在我们先前关于V1和V2数据集的基准中,我们用Stochastic Gradient Egency(SGD)优化器进行了所有实验。 虽然SGD被广泛采用,但我们观察到对学习率的趋同程度较慢并更加敏感,这影响了培训稳定性和跨实验环境的再生产性.

blocks.en:
To determine whether these optimization-related factors influenced the conclusions drawn from V1 and V2, we revisited the optimization strategy for the V3 dataset. Specifically, we replaced SGD with the Adam optimizer, which combines adaptive learning rates with momentum-based updates to improve convergence. As illustrated in
Figure 2 , Adam converges faster and more stably than SGD across the evaluated experiments.
blocks.zh:
为了确定这些优化相关因素是否影响从V1和V2得出的结论,我们重新审视了V3数据集的优化战略. 具体地说,我们用亚当优化器取代了SGD,后者结合了适应性学习率和以动力为基础的更新,以提高趋同性. 如所示
图2 亚当在整个被评价的实验中,聚集速度快,比SGD更稳定.

blocks.en: Based on these findings, we performed all subsequent experiments in this paper using Adam. Using a single optimization strategy lets the remainder of the study focus on the effects of the proposed architectures and experimental configurations while minimizing variability introduced by the optimization process. Therefore, unless otherwise stated, all results presented in the following sections correspond to models trained with the Adam optimizer. Although Adam generally converges well before 50 epochs, as shown in both the experimental results and Figure 2 , we keep this training duration to ensure a consistent evaluation protocol and consistent comparisons across the five independent runs. Hence, all RMSE values reported below are those at the end of 50 epochs, not the best value within the 50 epochs, except in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 基于这些发现,我们用亚当在本文中进行了所有后来的实验. 采用单一优化策略,使研究的其余部分侧重于拟议架构和实验配置的效果,同时将优化过程带来的可变性降到最低. 因此,除非另有说明,以下各节介绍的所有结果都与经过亚当优化器培训的模型相匹配. 虽然亚当一般在50个纪元之前就汇合了,如实验结果和图2所示,但我们保持这一培训期限,以确保在5个独立运行中有一个一致的评价协议和一致的比较。 因此,下文报告的所有RMSE值都是50个纪元后期的值,而不是50个纪元内的最佳值,附录A除外。

blocks.en: 4.5.3 Comparison between Single-Channel Models
blocks.zh: 4.5.3 单一渠道模式之间的比较

blocks.en: A comparison between the WP and AU datasets reveals task-dependent performance asymmetries. For pressure regression, WP consistently achieves lower RMSE values than AU across the evaluated channels and image types. For example, WP achieves a best pressure RMSE of 6.56 hPa (Channel 1, Full images, ResNet-18), compared with 7.20 hPa for AU under the same configuration.
blocks.zh: 对工作方案和非盟数据集的比较表明,业绩不对称取决于任务。 对于压力回归,WP在评估的信道和图像类型上始终实现低于非盟的RMSE值. 例如,WP实现最大压力RMSE为6.56 hPa(Channel 1,Full images,ResNet-18),而非盟在同一配置下达到7.20 hPa.

blocks.en: In contrast, AU substantially outperforms WP on the wind regression task. The lowest RMSE observed in WP is 15.67 kt (Channel 2, Full images, ResNet-18), whereas the lowest RMSE observed in AU is 10.75 kt (Channel 1, Full images, ResNet-50). Thus, the AU dataset achieves a lower wind regression error by approximately 4.9 kt in the best-performing configurations.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,非盟在风向回归任务方面的业绩大大高于工作方案。 在WP中观测到的最低RMSE为15.67 kt (Channel 2, Full images, ResNet-18),而在非盟中观测到的最低RMSE为10.75 kt (Channel 1, Full images, ResNet-50). 因此,非盟数据集在最佳配置中实现了约4.9克特的更低风回归误差.

blocks.en: These results show that benchmark performance differs systematically between the WP and AU datasets by target variable. WP shows lower RMSE for pressure regression, whereas AU shows lower RMSE for wind regression. This asymmetry stems from several factors across the two hemispheres. 1. The WP dataset is larger than the AU dataset, which favors the WP models for pressure regression. 2. Superior wind-regression performance in the AU dataset may reflect differences in data definitions and quality between hemispheres, driven by different operational procedures in regional meteorological agencies [ 15 ] . But it is unclear how this affects model performance.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,基准业绩按目标变量分列,在工作方案和非盟数据集之间有系统差异。 WP显示压力回归的RMSE较低,而AU显示风回归的RMSE较低. 这种不对称来自两个半球的若干因素。 1. WP数据集大于非盟数据集,该数据集有利于WP模型进行压力回归. 2. 非盟数据集中较高的回风性能可能反映各区域气象机构不同业务程序所驱动的半球之间在数据定义和质量上的差异[15]. 但尚不清楚这如何影响模型性能.

blocks.en:
For multi-channel benchmarking, we want to assess the effect of adding new channels.
For a fair comparison, we must use the same dataset to train and evaluate single-channel and multi-channel models. The multi-channel dataset, introduced in Section 4.1 , addresses this by creating a filtered dataset that is the intersection of the four channels. If we train and evaluate all models on this dataset, we can train single-channel and multi-channel models on the same dataset for both WP and AU hemispheres and directly compare channel relevance on the same basis. However, the multi-channel dataset has smaller temporal coverage and a smaller dataset size due to filtering.
Here, single-channel baselines in Table 7 and Table 8 show the effect of this filtering. This compares the same model trained on a larger dataset (single-channel) and a smaller dataset (multi-channel), so performance differences can be attributed to training-set size.
blocks.zh:
关于多渠道基准,我们希望评估增加新渠道的效果。
为了进行公平的比较,我们必须使用同样的数据集来训练和评价单渠道和多渠道模式。 第4.1节中引入的多频道数据集,通过创建一个作为四个频道相接点的被过滤数据集来解决这个问题. 如果我们在这个数据集上训练和评价所有模型,我们可以在同一数据集上为WP和AU半球培训单频道和多频道模型,并在相同的基础上直接比较信道的相关性. 然而,多通道数据集的时间覆盖范围较小,由于过滤,数据集的大小也较小.
这里,表7和表8中的单通道基线显示了这种过滤的效果. 这比较了在更大的数据集(单声道)和更小的数据集(多声道)上训练的同一种模型,所以性能差异可以归因于培训-集大小.

blocks.en: We used ResNet-18 and "Full" as the image type, as this setting performed best in the single-channel benchmark (Section 4.5 ). For data splitting, we employed season-level splitting (SS-L2), with the 2024–2025 seasons serving as the evaluation set.

blocks.en: More importantly, both tables show that, despite the intuitive appeal of incorporating multiple input channels to improve model performance, the empirical evidence does not consistently justify the additional computational cost. Across both datasets, the performance gains from combining channels are marginal.

blocks.en:
• Optimizer: Adam converges faster and more stably than SGD and is therefore used for all subsequent experiments. • Single-channel pressure regression: ResNet-18 generally provides better, more stable performance than ResNet-50 across the evaluated configurations, although ResNet-50 achieves a slightly lower RMSE in some individual settings. Channel 1 with Full-resolution images provides the best performance, achieving an RMSE of 6.56 hPa on WP and 7.20 hPa on AU. • Single-channel wind regression: ResNet-18 with Full-resolution images achieves the best observed performance for WP using Channel 2 (15.67 kt). For AU, ResNet-50 with Channel 1 and Full-resolution images achieves the best result (10.75 kt). • Hemispheric differences: Performance differs between the WP and AU datasets by target variable. WP exhibits lower RMSE for pressure regression, whereas AU exhibits substantially lower RMSE for wind regression. These differences reflect dataset- and task-specific characteristics rather than experimental choices. • Multi-channel inputs: Adding multiple spectral channels does not clearly improve the best single-channel model for pressure regression.
The best multi-channel models achieve an RMSE of 6.83 hPa on WP (Channel 1 + 2 + 3) and 8.44 hPa on AU (Channel 1 + 2). • Dataset size versus spectral information: The multi-channel dataset is smaller because we retain an observation only when all required channels are simultaneously available. blocks.en: 5 Analyzing Systematic Bias in Intensity Regression
blocks.zh: 5 分析强度递减中的系统性偏差

blocks.en: 5.1 Systematic Bias in Intensity Regression
blocks.zh: 5.1 强度递减的系统性偏见

blocks.en:
As discussed in Section 3 , dataset users have already noticed degraded performance in intensity regression for strong typhoons.
We did not analyze performance by intensity in our previous benchmarking for the Digital Typhoon Dataset because we averaged regression performance over all typhoon strengths, including strong and weak typhoons. By averaging, we could compare model configurations, channels, and hemispheres. Breaking down performance by intensity may provide practical guidance for improving the regression model.
blocks.zh:
如第3节所讨论,数据集用户已经注意到强烈台风强度回归的退化性能。
我们没有在先前的 " 数字台风数据集 " 基准中根据强度分析业绩,因为我们对包括强弱台风在内的所有台风强项进行了平均回归业绩分析。 通过平均,我们可以比较模型的配置,通道,和半球。 按强度细分性能可为改进回归模型提供实用指导.

blocks.en: The first approach is to employ more complex model architectures, such as ViT and ConvNeXT. However, the previous result showed that a simpler model, ResNet-18, generally performs better than a more complex model, ResNet-50, suggesting that increasing model complexity may not be the right path to improving intensity regression.
blocks.zh: 第一种方法是采用更复杂的模型架构,如VIT和ConvNEXT. 然而,先前的结果显示,一个更简单的模型ResNet-18一般表现优于一个更复杂的模型ResNet-50,这表明模型日益复杂可能不是改善强度回归的正确途径.

blocks.en: To explore an alternative path, we examine the error distribution across intensities, with a special focus on strong typhoons. This is because strong typhoons have a larger impact on society. For disaster preparedness, the loss function for forecasting error is not uniform, and performance improvements for stronger typhoons matter more than for weaker ones. However, when we evaluate performance on the entire dataset, it tends to optimize for weak typhoons because the dataset is biased toward them. Thus, this study aims to compensate for this bias and improve performance for strong typhoons.
blocks.zh: 为了探索另一条路径,我们考察了各种强度的误差分布,特别侧重于强台风. 这是因为强台风对社会的影响更大. 就备灾而言,预测错误的损失功能并不统一,强台风的性能改进比弱台风更重要. 然而,当我们评估整个数据集的性能时,它倾向于优化弱台风,因为数据集偏向于它们. 因此,本研究旨在弥补这种偏差并改进强台风的性能.

blocks.en: Here we distinguish three possible sources of error: data sparsity for strong typhoons, regression to the mean induced by the MSE objective, and limitations in the information available from a single satellite image. These effects are not mutually exclusive. The first two may reflect the training strategy, whereas the latter may reflect an intrinsic limitation of the input.
blocks.zh: 在此,我们区分出三种可能的错误来源:强台风的数据充斥;微电子目标所引发的平均值回归;从单一卫星图像获得的信息有限。 这些影响并非相互排斥。 前两项可能反映培训战略,而后两项可能反映投入的内在局限性。

blocks.en: In this section, we use the term systematic bias descriptively to denote the dependence of prediction error on the true pressure. For a pressure bin B B , we define the bias as the conditional mean error: b ⁡ ( B ) = 𝔼 ⁡ [ y ^ − y ∣ y ∈ B ] , b(B)=\mathbb{E}[\hat{y}-y\mid y\in B], (1) where y ^ \hat{y} denotes the predicted pressure and y y the true central pressure. A non-zero value of b ⁡ ( B ) b(B) does not by itself imply a defect in the regression model. In particular, when the target cannot be fully determined from the input image, an MSE-trained model may exhibit regression-to-the-mean behavior, producing predictions closer to the average pressure. We therefore interpret the observed intensity-dependent error as a descriptive property of the model predictions rather than attributing it to a single underlying cause.

blocks.en: We evaluate the bias between predicted and true pressure values using a sliding-window validation approach. Specifically, we trained the WP-1 dataset using ResNet-18 with full-resolution images for each consecutive-year pair from 1978 to 2024, excluding the target pair from the training set, and validated the model on that pair alone. This resulted in 47 overlapping temporal validation splits (e.g., 1978–1979, 1979–1980, …, 2024–2025), each assessing the model’s ability to generalize to unseen temporal data, assuming no causal relationship across seasons. This analysis uses the 47 temporal splits directly rather than repeated runs on a fixed partition.
blocks.zh: 我们用滑窗验证方法评估预测和真实压力值之间的偏差。 具体来说,我们用ResNet-18对WP-1数据集进行了训练,从1978年到2024年,每对连续一年的一对都配有全分辨率的图像,把目标对从训练组中排除出来,并且仅在这两对上验证了模型. 这导致47个时间验证重叠(例如1978-1979年,1979-1980年,.,2024-2025年),每个模型都评估模型是否有能力将时间数据归纳为看不见的时间数据,假设各季之间没有因果关系. 这种分析直接使用47个时间分数,而不是在固定分区上重复运行.

blocks.en:
We evaluate performance on a pressure regression task, where lower central pressure means stronger typhoons. As a result, we find a systematic bias in intensity regression, as shown in Figure 3 . The model underestimates strong typhoons and overestimates weak ones. Errors are especially large for pressures below 920 hPa across all splits, with the mean bias (blue curve) exceeding 10 hPa in the most extreme cases. This pattern is particularly pronounced for the strongest typhoons, for which the observed prediction error is substantially larger.
This may be related to the underrepresentation of strong typhoons in the training data, as less than 1% of samples have pressures below 920 hPa. This result may reflect regression-to-the-mean behavior, where predictions for high-magnitude events are pulled toward the average.

这可能与培训数据中强烈台风代表不足有关,因为不到1%的样本压力低于920 hPa. 这一结果可能反映回归到正局行为,即高强度事件的预测被拉向平均值.

blocks.en: To address systematic bias for strong typhoons, we explore two strategies in Section 5.2 and Section 5.3 : sample weighting to account for the underrepresentation of extreme events, and an inverse-density weighting strategy inspired by BalancedMSE to further investigate the effect of target-density-aware weighting. These approaches aim to reduce the bias for extreme cases while maintaining robust performance across all pressure ranges.
blocks.zh: 为了解决对强台风的系统性偏差,我们探索了第5.2节和第5.3节中的两项战略:抽样加权,以说明极端事件代表性不足的情况,以及由平衡、管理和环境所启发的反密度加权战略,以进一步调查目标密度-认识加权的影响。 这些办法旨在减少极端情况下的偏差,同时保持所有压力范围的强劲性能。

blocks.en: 5.2 Sample Weighting
blocks.zh: 5.2 抽样加权

blocks.en:
To address the underrepresentation of strong typhoons, we implemented a multi-faceted weighting strategy inspired by imbalanced learning techniques. This approach combines static and dynamic components to emphasize rare or hard-to-predict samples. All experiments in this section use the WP-1 dataset with the SS-L2 split (2024–2025), retaining the last two seasons for evaluation, as described in Table 4 . Each weighting configuration was evaluated using five independent training runs on this fixed partition. For the adaptive weighting procedure, we compute the model’s per-bin RMSE on the training set at the end of each training epoch and use the resulting values to update the weights for the subsequent epoch.
We reserve the held-out 2024–2025 set exclusively for reporting final benchmark performance and do not use it to compute the per-bin RMSE that drives adaptive weight updates. This protocol is intentionally used to study whether dynamically emphasizing poorly predicted pressure ranges can reduce the systematic bias toward the mean.

blocks.en: The experiments in this section are conducted for the WP-1 dataset with the same SS-L2 split (2024–2025) as in Section 5.2 , using the same 10 hPa pressure bins. The standard Mean Squared Error (MSE) loss is dominated by the most frequent pressure ranges, which may contribute to the systematic regression-to-the-mean behavior observed for strong typhoons. This issue is well documented in imbalanced regression, where the distribution of training targets can strongly affect regression performance [ 28 ] .

blocks.en: 5.4 Future Directions for Intensity Regression
blocks.zh: 5.4 强度递减的未来方向

blocks.en: The results presented in this section suggest several directions for future research on intensity regression for strong typhoons. Since the Digital Typhoon Dataset V3 already incorporates all the historically available observations under its current construction, future improvements should not rely simply on increasing the number of observations. Instead, they should focus on using the existing data more effectively and developing models better suited to the characteristics of extreme events.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍的结果为今后研究强台风强度回落提出了几个方向. 由于"数字台风数据集V3"已经将所有历史可用的观测数据都纳入其目前的构造中,因此未来的改进不应仅仅依赖于增加观测数量. 相反,它们应侧重于更有效地利用现有数据并开发更适合极端事件特点的模型。

blocks.en: One promising direction is to investigate alternative learning strategies for imbalanced regression, including improved formulations of density-aware loss functions and adaptive weighting schemes. Such methods could reduce regression-to-the-mean behavior while limiting the overall performance degradation seen with stronger weighting schemes. Another direction is to investigate prediction calibration or uncertainty-aware approaches, which could provide more reliable estimates for the rarest and most intense typhoons.
blocks.zh: 一个有希望的方向是调查不平衡回归的替代学习战略,包括改进密度意识丧失功能的表述和适应性加权办法。 这种方法可以减少回归到实际行为,同时通过更强的权重方案限制总体性能退化。 另一个方向是调查预测校正或认识不确定性的方法,这可以为最罕见和最强烈的台风提供更可靠的估计.

blocks.en: Future work could also explore using additional information already associated with the observations, such as temporal context or complementary meteorological variables, provided these extensions remain consistent with the benchmark design. In particular, incorporating temporal sequences rather than treating satellite images independently may help models better capture the physical evolution of rapidly intensifying or weakening tropical cyclones.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作还可以利用已经与观测有关的额外信息,如时间背景或补充气象变量,只要这些扩展与基准设计保持一致。 特别是,纳入时间序列而不是独立处理卫星图像可能有助于模型更好地捕捉迅速增强或减弱的热带气旋的物理演进。

blocks.en: Data augmentation requires particular caution for this dataset. Unlike generic image-recognition tasks, transformations applied to satellite observations may alter physically meaningful structures or introduce unrealistic cyclone configurations. Consequently, conventional geometric or photometric augmentation is inappropriate for this dataset, and this study intentionally did not use it. If future work considers augmentation, it should instead use transformations that preserve the physical interpretation of the observations and validate them carefully.
blocks.zh: 数据扩增需要对这个数据集特别谨慎. 与一般图像识别任务不同,卫星观测应用的转换可能改变物理上有意义的结构或引入不切实际的气旋配置. 因此,传统的几何或光度增强不适合这一数据集,本研究有意没有使用。 如果未来工作考虑增强,则应当采用能够保留观测结果的物理解释并仔细加以验证的转变。

blocks.en: Overall, future research should focus on better exploiting existing observations, developing imbalance-aware and physically informed learning strategies, and better representing the temporal and physical characteristics of strong tropical cyclones.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,未来的研究应侧重于更好地利用现有观测结果,制定对不平衡的认识和实际知情的学习战略,并更好地反映强烈热带气旋的时间和物理特征。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we presented the Digital Typhoon Dataset V3, extended it to spectral dimensions, and opened new research avenues for tropical cyclone analysis. The spectral dimension enables the development of multi-channel models, addressing a long-standing need in tropical cyclone research. However, our benchmarking experiments (Section 4.6 ) show that multi-channel inputs do not clearly improve pressure regression in the current setting. This highlights a critical trade-off: while richer spectral information is theoretically valuable, the reduction in dataset size (due to missing channels) may limit the model’s ability to learn robust features. This limitation is particularly relevant for strong typhoons, which are already under-represented in the data.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了数字台风数据集V3,将其扩展至光谱维度,并为热带气旋分析开辟了新的研究途径. 光谱维度使多频道模型得以发展,满足了热带气旋研究的长期需要. 然而,我们的基准试验(第4.6节)表明,多渠道的投入并没有明显改善当前环境下的压力回落。 这突出了一种关键的取舍:虽然较丰富的光谱信息在理论上是有价值的,但数据集大小的缩小(因为缺少通道)可能限制模型学习强健特性的能力。 这一限制与强烈台风特别相干,因为这些台风在数据中已经不足。

blocks.en: Our experiments in Section 5 further investigate this challenge. The strategies we investigate—sample weighting and inverse-density weighting inspired by BalancedMSE—reduce bias for extreme cases but do not fully eliminate regression-to-the-mean behavior. This suggests that both dataset constraints and model limitations contribute to the difficulty of analyzing strong typhoons.
blocks.zh: 我们在第五区的实验 进一步调查这一挑战。 我们所调查的战略——以平衡MSE的启发为例的加权和反密度加权——减少了极端情况下的偏差,但并没有完全消除回归到正反行为。 这表明,数据集限制和模型限制都造成了分析强台风的困难.

blocks.en: Together, these contributions in dataset development and modeling strategies provide a foundation for future work to improve tropical cyclone intensity regression, particularly for extreme events.
blocks.zh: 这些在数据集开发和建模战略方面的贡献共同为今后改善热带气旋强度回归,特别是针对极端事件的工作奠定了基础。
